text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
SpecializeInTranslating(x, y) ::: x specializes in translating y.
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: y is published by x.
Language(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from language y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.

Premises:
PublishingHouse(newVesselPress) ∧ ∀x (PublishedBy(newVesselPress, x) → Language(x, english)) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English. All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
PublishedBy(newVesselPress, neapolitanChronicles) ∧ TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press. Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
PublishedBy(newVesselPress, palaceOfFlies) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.

Conclusion:
Language(neapolitanChronicles, english) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is an English book.
